explanationMd: The absolute values are distances from −1 and 5. A point on the real line equidistant from these two distinct points is their midpoint, (−1 + 5)/2 = 2. Each distance is then three.

distractorRationale.d: This uses half the distance between the points without adding the left endpoint.
distractorRationale.c: This is the distance between the two reference points, not their midpoint.
distractorRationale.b: Only points equidistant from −1 and 5 satisfy the equation on a line.
